compared.difference: Different object and different section: the surplus-independence lemma behind the (K,L)-greedoid theorem, with no bipartite graph, butterfly graph or forest decomposition in it; it is not used here.
Counts the pebble-game soundness and completeness corollaries for (K,L)-sparsity; different propositions in a different section, and no arboricity statement.

reference/public-items.jsonl has 1 row containing arboricity (182297, New bounds for linear arboricity and related problems), which is about linear arboricity of graphs and has no bipartite sparsity parameter, no butterfly multigraph and no added-edge hypothesis. reference/retired-claims.json has 0 of 400 entries for this source.

The 3 rows containing butterfly (1053 quantum cluster quiver, 185003 cops-and-robbers graph lemma, 203675 Hofstadter butterfly) do not involve the (k1,k2)-fold butterfly multigraph of a bipartite graph.
Its draft from this source is the layered pebble recognition task only; the bipartite arboricity theorem of section 2 lies in its recorded read range 1-510 but was never drafted or counted.
